errors: Claims FK columns are covered by indexes, but repo_*_grants.granted_by (ON DELETE SET NULL) has no index, so deleting a user scans the grant tables (minor)
CITEXT needs the citext extension, not mentioned (minor)
A.note: Query-first, tight schema with composite same-org FKs, a correct indexed access check, explicit rejection of polymorphic/nullable/list alternatives, and a correct last-admin note.

errors: States every FK column not leading an index got its own index, but granted_by (ON DELETE SET NULL) is unindexed (minor)
B.note: Nearly identical strong design with an ordered enum and max(), clear polymorphic-vs-nullable trade-off and a sensible when-to-denormalise scale note.

errors: granted_by REFERENCES users(id) with default NO ACTION: deleting any user who ever granted access fails, contradicting the cascade intent

team_memberships has no constraint that the member belongs to the team's org; removal from org relies on application code to clean team memberships, so a former member can keep team access if that path is missed
Point lookup through a GROUP BY/UNION ALL view relies on planner predicate pushdown; plausible but asserted without caveat
C.note: Good view-based single access function and clear rejected alternative, but leaves the team-member-in-org invariant to application code and has a user-deletion FK bug.

errors: granted_by on repo_user_grants is ON DELETE SET NULL but unindexed despite the claim that every deletable FK gets an index (minor)
D.note: Very solid: invariants written first, composite FKs, a correctly justified extra index for the org_memberships cascade, correct last-admin locking and concrete tests, but no explicit discussion of the single polymorphic grant table alternative and some scope creep (base permission).

errors: Lists outside collaborators as not modelled although the schema already allows direct grants to non-members (inconsistency, minor)
E.note: Compact and correct, with case-insensitive unique indexes, derived org-admin access, a visibility branch in the access query and clear key choices with alternatives.

errors: granted_by BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) with no ON DELETE action: a user who ever granted access can never be deleted
BIGINT PRIMARY KEY without identity/sequence leaves id generation unspecified (minor)
Direct grants require org membership, excluding outside collaborators (acknowledged, but a weaker fit for GitHub semantics)
F.note: Strong reasoning with named queries Q1-Q7 and clear flip conditions (Zanzibar-style ACL, separate admins table), but longer than needed and has the granted_by deletion bug.
